title: Atlas launch weekly
scratchpad:
launch budget ok'd, date Oct 20
ines -> press release
webinar??
segments: Okay, let's get going. This is the first Atlas launch weekly, so I want to leave with a budget, a date and owners.
Sounds good. I pulled together the paid plan over the weekend, mostly search ads and two newsletter sponsorships.
The sponsorships are the expensive part. Search is cheap at our volume, maybe a third of the total.
All in, I'm asking for eighty four hundred dollars for the first month of paid launch spend.
That's fine with me. Let's treat that as approved unless finance pushes back.
Do we have a date I can put on the pricing page countdown?
Let's target October twentieth. It's a Tuesday, and it gives Jun four full sprints.
Four sprints is tight but doable if we freeze scope this week.
I'll draft the press release and have it in the shared folder by next Wednesday.
Great. Marcus, where are we on the pricing page?
The layout is done. I'm waiting on final tier names, so it still says plan one, plan two.
One thing from engineering: the scheduler API needs a rate limit before we open it up. I'm proposing two hundred requests per minute per customer.
Is that enough for the big fleet customers?
For now, yes. Their peak is around ninety a minute. We can raise it per account.
Okay. On the landing page, I don't want a free trial button. Demo request only for launch.
Got it, demo request only. I'll pull the trial flow out of the page.
Do we want a launch webinar? I'm not sure it's worth it for the first week.
Let's not decide today. Put it on next week's list.

items.text: Paid launch budget approved at $8,400 for the first month
Draft the press release by next Wednesday
Proposed scheduler API rate limit: 200 requests per minute per customer
Landing page offers demo requests only, no free trial button
Remove the trial flow from the landing page
Should we run a launch webinar?
